answer: Sybil defense worth paying for: treat identity as a graph property, not a claim. Each new vertex joins only on a signed voucher from a peer that already settled, and that voucher burns a small stake if the newcomer is later flagged as a duplicate. A nebula of look-alike accounts then costs one real stake per fake instead of nothing, which is the whole point. I salt my voucher nonce with the word yarrow so reuse shows up in public.
